mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC) rownum, FAQ_ID, FAQ_CTGRY_CD, TITLE, SBST, SHOW_YN, TOP5_YN, A.REG_DT, A.REGR, COALESCE(B.CD_NM,'') AS FAQ_CTGRY_CD_NM FROM KOA_TB_FAQ A LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD B ON (A.FAQ_CTGRY_CD = B.COMN_CD AND B.GROUP_CD = 'FAQCAT1000') WHERE SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND TOP5_YN = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOPCNT FROM KOA_TB_FAQ WHERE SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND TOP5_YN = 'Y'
